items.title: 8.2 Reversible reactions, microscopic waqiat aur dynamic equilibrium (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.2, printed pages 168-170.

blocks.text: Jab reversible reaction equilibrium par ho to woh sakin lagti hai, magar microscopic satah par reaction kabhi nahi rukti: reactant molecules products mein badalte rehte hain jabke ulta amal ek hi waqt hota hai. Munasib halaat mein steam aur carbon monoxide ke react karne par ghaur karein, H2O(g) + CO(g) se H2(g) + CO2(g), dono reactants ke barabar moles se shuru karte hue. Milane par macroscopic tabdeeliyan dekhi jati hain (concentration ki tabdeeliyan), aur microscopic satah par H2O aur CO ke darmiyan fi second collisions ki zyada se zyada tadaad shuru mein hoti hai; CO aur H2O ke bonds tootte aur naye bonds ban kar H2 aur CO2 dete hain, to forward reaction ki rate shuru mein zyada se zyada hai. Jaise H2O aur CO kharch hote hain forward reaction sust hoti hai. Jaise H2 aur CO2 jama hote hain reverse reaction shuru hoti hai; un ki barhti concentrations ke saath un ke darmiyan fi second zyada se zyada collisions hote hain, H2 aur CO2 ke bonds tootte aur CO aur H2O ke bonds bante hain, to reverse rate kam se shuru ho kar batadreej barhti aur aakhir mein mustaqil ho jati hai. Aakhir mein dono reactions ek hi rate se chalti hain: reaction chemical equilibrium mein hai aur reactants aur products ki concentrations mustaqil hain, aur jab tak system ko chhera na jaye koi mazeed tabdeeli nahi hoti.

blocks.alt: Waqt ke muqable concentration ka graph. Neela curve [CO] ya [H2O] oonchi jagah se shuru ho kar girta hai; magenta curve [CO2] ya [H2] sifar se uthta hai aur neele curve ko kaat-ta hai. Dashed khari lakeer 'Equilibrium' par dono curves seedhe (flat) ho jate hain, magenta neele se oopar.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.1: Waqt ke muqable concentration ka plot ([CO] ya [H2O] aur [CO2] ya [H2]) (kitab ki Figure 8.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Hamara apna graph: waqt ke muqable rate. Surkh 'forward rate' oonchi jagah se girta hai, neela 'reverse rate' sifar se uthta hai; dashed lakeer par dono barabar ho kar ek seedhi lakeer ban jate hain (rates equal: equilibrium).
blocks.caption: H2O + CO ke liye forward aur reverse rates waqt ke saath (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh graph nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle graph mein shuru mein sirf CO aur H2O hain, is liye un ki concentration oonchi hai aur girti hai, jabke H2 aur CO2 sifar se barhte hain. Dashed lakeer ke baad dono lakeerein seedhi hain: equilibrium par concentrations nahi badaltin. Doosra (hamara) graph wajah dikhata hai: forward rate girta aur reverse rate barhta hai, aur jab dono barabar ho jate hain to equilibrium aa jata hai.

blocks.title: Chemical equilibrium ki halat
blocks.text: Reversible reaction ki woh halat jis par reaction mixture ki tarkeeb nahi badalti aur forward aur reverse rates barabar hain chemical equilibrium ki halat hai.

Product B mein badalte reactant A ke liye waqt ke muqable concentration ke plots equilibrium ke baad ke imkanat dikhate hain: reactant aur product ki concentrations barabar ho sakti hain, ya reactant product se kam ya zyada, magar har soorat mein equilibrium qaim hone par concentrations mustaqil ho jati hain. Jab concentrations mustaqil ho jayein to reaction ruki hui lag sakti hai, magar microscopic satah par shadeed sargarmi hai: alag alag reactant molecules react karte rehte hain aur alag alag product molecules mil kar reactants mein wapas jate rehte hain, aur forward amal ki rate reverse ki rate ke bilkul barabar hai. Is liye yeh dynamic equilibrium hai: system dynamic hai kyunke molecules musalsal react kar rahe hain, jabke dono rates ek jaisi hain.

blocks.alt: Teen graphs: waqt ke muqable reactant A (neela, girta hua) aur product B (magenta, uthta hua) ki concentration. Har graph mein dashed khari lakeer 'Equilibrium' ke baad dono curves seedhe hain. (a) A aur B barabar concentration par ruk jate hain. (b) A, B se neeche rukta hai. (c) A, B se oopar rukta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.1: Waqt ke muqable concentration ka plot (a) Reactant = Product (b) Reactant < Product (c) Reactant > Product (kitab ki Figure 8.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: H2O(g) + CO(g) se H2(g) + CO2(g) ke liye equilibrium par products zyada ghane hain. Waqt ke muqable concentration aur rate ke graphs bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Concentration: H2O aur CO ke curves oonche shuru ho kar girte hain, H2 aur CO2 ke curves sifar se shuru ho kar barhte hain, aur equilibrium waqt ke baad product curves reactant curves ke oopar hamwar chalte hain. Rate: forward rate apni intiha se shuru ho kar girti hai, reverse rate sifar se shuru ho kar barhti hai, aur dono curves mil kar phir ek ufqi lakeer ke taur par saath chalte hain.

items: H2O + CO se H2 + CO2 mein forward rate apni intiha se shuru ho kar reactants kharch hone ke saath girti hai, jabke reverse rate sifar se shuru ho kar products jama hone ke saath barhti hai; rates barabar hone par tarkeeb badalna band: chemical equilibrium.
Equilibrium dynamic hai: molecules barabar rates se dono taraf react karte rehte hain, chahe aakhri concentrations barabar hon ya nahi.
